_comment: NorthRay Capture's app registrations with Twitch and Google (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Signing in'). These IDs are public by design: desktop apps can't keep secrets, and Google treats a desktop client's secret as non-confidential. Empty means sign-in isn't offered for that service. A copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NorthRay\Capture\oauth-clients.json overrides these, for testing a registration without rebuilding.
